ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels across ~80% of surface area with high-intensity (white) pixels localized in discrete clusters on the distal lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Right distal lobe contains a contiguous, irregular high-intensity white geometric blob. Both lobes exhibit discrete, non-contiguous circular white clusters (mottling) against the low-intensity background.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central notch with a deep vertical bounding-box recession dividing the lobe junctions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Moderate frequency of irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) observed along the entire trailing edge boundary, with greater amplitude variations on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: General convex curve extending from the median notch, transitioning to a slight upward concavity as the trajectory reaches the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters on the right distal lobe and scattered across the central-left lobe area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular, high-relief pixel clusters (encrustations) present on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, disrupting the smooth geometric boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-contrast 'leopard' mottling pattern localized on the inner right distal region.
